events.title: RENT: The Musical
events.description:
Experience the groundbreaking Tony Award-winning musical and Pulitzer Prize-winning drama that defined a generation. Presented at Art House Productions during the 30th anniversary year of its original premiere, RENT follows a vibrant community of artists, musicians, and dreamers in New York City’s East Village as they pursue their passions, navigate love and loss, and strive to make a meaningful impact on the world around them.

Set against the backdrop of the AIDS crisis, poverty, addiction, economic uncertainty, and a rapidly changing city, these artists discover the power of friendship, the importance of creative expression, and the enduring strength of community. Featuring iconic songs and an unforgettable rock score, RENT celebrates resilience, human connection, and the transformative role of the arts in times of hardship.

This production is especially meaningful as part of Art House Productions’ 25th Anniversary Season. Founded in the wake of September 11, 2001, Art House was created to bring people together through the arts during a time of profound loss and uncertainty. Thirty years after its premiere, RENT remains as relevant, timeless, and inspiring as ever, reminding us all to measure our lives in love.

events.title: Jersey City Poetry Festival 2026
events.description:
The Jersey City Poetry Festival (JCPOFEST) is an interdisciplinary, intergenerational event taking place September 25–27 under this year’s theme “Viva! Joy as Resistance.” This multi-venue celebration fuses poetry with music, dance, visual art, storytelling, and film—bringing generations, disciplines, and communities together to imagine, question, connect, and experience the radical possibility of collective JOY. Showcasing an extraordinary constellation of emerging and critically acclaimed voices, the festival features 5th U.S. Presidential Inaugural Poet Richard Blanco, the Grammy-performing Resistance Revival Chorus, and a panel with poets from Cave Canem (represented by Pulitzer Prize finalist Evie Shockley), Kundiman, and CantoMundo.

FESTIVAL AT A GLANCE I JCPOFEST 2026

9/25 — Kick-Off Party & VIP Networking | The Stork Club I 7pm -11pm I Venue: Chapel Ave. Jersey City, NJ 07305

9/26 — SYNERGY: Interdisciplinary Exploration of Poetry | 3pm -9pm | Venue: MONIRA FOUNDATION Address: Mana Contemporary 888 Newark Ave, Jersey City, NJ 07306

9/27 — Lazul: An Eco-Centric Group Exhibition | 301 West Side Ave. Jersey City, NJ 07305
May–November — The Pursuit of Happiness | Museum of Jersey City History I Saturday & Wednesdays 1pm – 5pm

For more information: www.jcpofest.org

events.title: The Society of American Graphic Artists (SAGA) 91st Annual Members Exhibition 2026
events.description:
91st Annual Members Exhibition

The Society of American Graphic Artists (SAGA) is excited to announce its upcoming 91st Annual Members Exhibition, to be held at Mana Contemporary in Jersey City from September 11–27, 2026 (Fridays and Saturdays, 3:00–7:00 PM; Sundays, 12:00–3:00 PM).

The exhibition will feature 200 hand-pulled prints representing a broad range of printmaking techniques and subjects, created by SAGA artists from across the country. Awards will be juried by Leslie Diuguid, founder of Du-Good Press in Brooklyn.

The Society of American Graphic Artists (SAGA) is a nonprofit organization established in 1915 whose mission is to promote contemporary printmakers, cultivate printmaking appreciation and education, and provide a collaborative and inclusive platform for artists across the country.

https://sagaprints.com/

Hosting this year’s exhibition is Monira Foundation, an independent nonprofit institution that functions as a radical experimental laboratory, working in close collaboration with artists, curators, musicians, dancers, producers, and writers to conceive, realize, and present innovative projects in all media. Monira is located within Mana Contemporary, a 2-million-square-foot art center. The complex occupies a renovated 100-year-old former tobacco warehouse, featuring expansive exhibition spaces, working artist studios, the International Center of Photography archives, and more.

A free public reception and awards ceremony with participating artists will be held on Saturday, September 26, from 3:00–5:00 PM. Guests are invited to enjoy light refreshments while celebrating the diversity and innovation of contemporary printmaking.

WHEN

Exhibition:
Fridays–Sundays, September 11–27, 2026

Public Reception & Awards Ceremony:
Saturday, September 26, 2026
3:00–5:00 PM

WHERE

Mana Contemporary
888 Newark Avenue
Jersey City, NJ 07306

events.title: Hamilton Park Farmers Market 2026
events.description:
Join us at the Hamilton Park Farmers Market, your midweek destination for fresh, local, and thoughtfully crafted food and goods. Each week, we’re proud to feature farm-fresh produce from Stony Hill Farm alongside a curated selection of specialty vendors.

Browse a variety of offerings including our long time vendor Pickles and Olives, fresh seafood from Scale Fish Market, and prepared foods perfect for dinner. You can also find baked goods, candles, personal care products, and more. You can even take advantage of convenient services like on-site knife sharpening while you shop.

On the first and second Wednesdays of each month, enjoy live entertainment that adds to the vibrant, community atmosphere of the market.

Whether you’re shopping for the week, grabbing a bite, or simply enjoying the park, the Hamilton Park Farmers Market is a welcoming space to connect with local vendors and neighbors.

Free Diapers: Luvs Wants You to Take Their Aid 2026
events.description:
Please Take Our Ad: Community Giving

Luvs is bringing its Give Back Billboard to Jersey City, turning an advertisement into an opportunity to directly support local families with free diapers.

From 12–6 p.m., families can visit Mary McLeod Bethune Park and take part in an interactive billboard made from Luvs diaper packs. As the packs are removed, the billboard will gradually reveal the message: “Leak protection shouldn’t be a luxury.”

For 50 years, Luvs has stood for value, and as families face the rising cost of raising children, the brand is bringing that commitment directly to the community through free diapers, giveaways and more.

One free box of diapers per household, while supplies last. Sizes subject to availability. No purchase necessary.

events.title: RENT: The Musical
events.description:
Experience the groundbreaking Tony Award-winning musical and Pulitzer Prize-winning drama that defined a generation. Presented at Art House Productions during the 30th anniversary year of its original premiere, RENT follows a vibrant community of artists, musicians, and dreamers in New York City’s East Village as they pursue their passions, navigate love and loss, and strive to make a meaningful impact on the world around them.

Set against the backdrop of the AIDS crisis, poverty, addiction, economic uncertainty, and a rapidly changing city, these artists discover the power of friendship, the importance of creative expression, and the enduring strength of community. Featuring iconic songs and an unforgettable rock score, RENT celebrates resilience, human connection, and the transformative role of the arts in times of hardship.

events.title: Hamilton Park Farmers Market 2026
events.description:
Join us at the Hamilton Park Farmers Market, your midweek destination for fresh, local, and thoughtfully crafted food and goods. Each week, we’re proud to feature farm-fresh produce from Stony Hill Farm alongside a curated selection of specialty vendors.

Browse a variety of offerings including our long time vendor Pickles and Olives, fresh seafood from Scale Fish Market, and prepared foods perfect for dinner. You can also find baked goods, candles, personal care products, and more. You can even take advantage of convenient services like on-site knife sharpening while you shop.

On the first and second Wednesdays of each month, enjoy live entertainment that adds to the vibrant, community atmosphere of the market.

Whether you’re shopping for the week, grabbing a bite, or simply enjoying the park, the Hamilton Park Farmers Market is a welcoming space to connect with local vendors and neighbors.
